reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clearing LHA Toner 265ml
reviews.text: it is so light! it doesn’t feel heavy or clogging. it also leaves a cooling effect that has helped calm the redness on my cheeks. i have rosacea and this has really helped with the normal redness and warmth on my face.
reviews.zh: 質地好輕！搽落唔會覺得厚重或者堵塞毛孔。仲會有涼感，可以幫助舒緩我面頰嘅泛紅。我有玫瑰痤瘡，佢真係幫到手處理一般嘅泛紅同面部發熱。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clearing LHA Toner 265ml
reviews.text: This is my 2nd purchase. It has LHA which helps with cleaning my pores. Watery consistency.Then I layer with essence, serum, moisturiser +/- sunscreen if it's morning.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第二次回購。含有 LHA 可以幫我清潔毛孔。質地水狀。之後我會疊加乳液、精華、面霜，早上嘅話加減防曬。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clearing LHA Toner 265ml
reviews.text: I was looking for a product that helps to reduce pore size and white/black heads/. After using this it feels that I am definitely getting this effect, though very minor. Though its minor effect, this is the best one I had yet so.
reviews.zh: 我一直想搵一款可以縮細毛孔同減少白頭、黑頭嘅產品。用完之後覺得確實有呢個效果，不過好輕微。雖然效果唔算大，但呢個已經係我用過最好嘅一款。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clearing LHA Toner 265ml
reviews.text: I love the refreshing feeling this toner gives. It provides a cooling and very refreshing sensation on the skin. It exfoliates in a very gentle way. My skin is very sensitive and prone to red breakouts on my cheeks, yet it suited me well. I usually apply about three layers of it along with a barrier-repair cream. It gently removes flaky skin in a safe way. If you have under-the-skin bumps, it may help bring them to the surface, but you need consistent use to see results. Overall, I really liked it.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支爽膚水帶嚟嘅清新感覺。搽喺皮膚上有涼爽同非常清新嘅感覺。佢嘅去角質好溫和。我皮膚好敏感，而且面頰容易泛紅爆瘡，但用落都好適合。我通常會疊搽三層，再配合一支修護屏障嘅面霜一齊用。佢可以溫和地去除死皮，又唔傷皮膚。如果你有皮下閉口，佢可能可以幫助逼出嚟，但要持續使用先見到效果。整體嚟講，我真係好鍾意。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clearing LHA Toner 265ml
reviews.text: This is a nice toner. I am really trying to find a balance in which toner really suits my skin. What I have found in many websites that advertise having the best facial rejuvenating products. I have not seen up to now or read any of them addressing woman in their 60's and up.
reviews.zh: 呢支爽膚水幾好用。我真係好努力想搵到一支真正適合自己膚質嘅爽膚水。好多網站都話自己有最好嘅面部煥膚產品，但到目前為止，我未見過、亦未睇過任何一個有針對60歲或以上女性嘅介紹。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clearing LHA Toner 265ml
reviews.text:
I have mature thinning skin which tends to superficial dryness in the winter months. I struggle with exfoliation because of this. Following a recommendation by a trusted male Korean influencer
I follow, I selected this toner because he scored it an S on one of his toner tier reviews. I find it gently exfoliates without irritation so have now happily introduced exfoliation into my weekly regime. My skin looks much healthier - smoother, brighter and even toned.
reviews.zh: 我係成熟肌，皮膚開始變薄，冬天幾個月會有表層乾燥嘅問題。因為咁，去角質對我嚟講好難搞。跟住我follow緊嘅一位可信嘅韓國男influencer嘅推薦，我揀咗呢支爽膚水，因為喺佢嘅爽膚水評級入面俾咗S級。佢溫和地去到角質又唔刺激，所以我好開心將去角質加入每星期嘅護膚程序。皮膚望落健康咗好多——更滑、更亮、膚色更均勻。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clearing LHA Toner 265ml
reviews.text: Not sure if I like it yet. Has been a couple of weeks using it. I don’t normally use a toner. This is my first. I was hoping it’ll control my blackheads on my nose a bit Not seeing any difference. I’ll have to use the whole bottle to fully asses.
reviews.zh: 仲未確定鍾唔鍾意。用咗幾個星期。我平時唔用爽膚水，呢個係我第一支。本來希望可以控制到鼻上嘅黑頭少少，而家睇唔到有咩分別。要用晒成支先可以完整評估。

reviews.shade: beplain Mung Bean Pore Clearing LHA Toner 265ml
reviews.text: The beplain Mung Bean Pore Clearing LHA Toner feels light and refreshing on the skin. It helps smooth out my skin’s texture and leaves it feeling clean and balanced. I like that it doesn’t feel harsh or drying, making it great for daily use. The packaging is simple and convenient to use, too. I’m happy to have this in my skincare routine!
reviews.zh: beplain 綠豆毛孔清理 LHA 爽膚水搽上面感覺輕盈清爽，有助撫平膚質，用完皮膚感覺乾淨同水油平衡。我鍾意佢唔會覺得刺激或者乾燥，適合每日使用。包裝簡單又方便用。好開心可以將佢加入護膚程序！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
